answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46992 Country: United Kingdom Title: Zakat Question: I came to London few years back, prior to that I was in Pakistan. My question is: should I calculate zakah according to the gold rate as of United Kingdom or should I use the gold rate of Pakistan from where I bought my jewellery. Answer ID: 46992 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1214/1039/H=10/1434) You should pay it keeping in mind the market price of the place where you are going to pay. It is good and preferable to pay it as per the high rate. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
